title: SEBI Proposes Raising Annual ISIN Limit for Private Debt Securities from 14 to 17
summary: SEBI proposed expanding annual ISIN limit maturing in a FY from 14 to 17 to ease NBFC refinancing pressure.

blocks.content: SEBI proposed expanding annual ISIN limit maturing in a FY from 14 to 17 to ease NBFC refinancing pressure.

items: **ISIN Limit Breakdown:** Plain-vanilla debt ISINs increased from **9 to 12**; Structured/FRBs/ZCBs/Tier-II ISIN limit remains **5**.
**Large Issuer Flexibility:** Once 12 ISINs reach **₹15,000 crore**, 1 additional ISIN permitted per further **₹3,000 crore** outstanding.
**Mandatory Listing Relief:** Removed requirement to mandatorily list all outstanding unlisted NCDs issued on/after Jan 1, 2024.
**Exclusion:** Sovereign/Government-serviced EBR bonds excluded from ISIN limits.

blocks.summary: ISIN: International Securities Identification Number (12-character alphanumeric code).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Limit Allocation:** Plain vanilla ISIN limit expanded (9->12), but structured debt ISIN limit remained UNCHANGED at 5.
